effects: Sends the signer's vested BLAST (token 0xb1a5700f…e2ad, a fixed value in the contract) from the vesting contract to the signer (msg.sender). The amount is the sum of every finished, unclaimed tranche for each address delegated to the signer.
Sets lastClaimedTimestamp to now for each address delegated to the signer. This uses up the tranches that have vested so far, so they cannot be claimed again.
No native currency moves; the function is not payable.
formats.shown: "Claim vested BLAST airdrop" with no fields; the tokens go to the signer.

findings.title: claim(): the BLAST amount is not shown because the contract works it out from stored balances and the schedule.
findings.evidence: AirdropVesting.sol claim(address): vestedAmount += _computeVestedAmount(initialRecipient, _schedule); BLAST_TOKEN.transfer(recipient, vestedAmount). There is no amount in the calldata. descriptor claim(): fields: [].
findings.fix: None possible in the descriptor. A wallet could show claimableBalance(signer) instead.

effects: Sends the signer's vested BLAST (token 0xb1a5700f…e2ad, a fixed value in the contract) from the vesting contract to `recipient`. The amount is the sum of every finished, unclaimed tranche for each address delegated to msg.sender, not to the recipient.
Sets lastClaimedTimestamp to now for each address delegated to the signer. This uses up the signer's vested tranches, even when the tokens go to another address.
Reverts if recipient is the zero address. No native currency moves; the function is not payable.
formats.shown: "Claim vested BLAST airdrop to {recipient}", with the recipient shown as an addressName field.

findings.title: claim(address): the BLAST amount is not shown because the contract works it out from stored balances and the schedule.
findings.evidence: AirdropVesting.sol claim(address): vestedAmount += _computeVestedAmount(...) over claimableAddresses[msg.sender]; BLAST_TOKEN.transfer(recipient, vestedAmount). There is no amount in the calldata.

findings.title: claim(address): the intent does not say the claim uses the signer's own vested allocation when sending to another address.
findings.evidence: AirdropVesting.sol claim(address): claimableAddresses[msg.sender] and lastClaimedTimestamp[initialRecipient] = block.timestamp; interpolatedIntent "Claim vested BLAST airdrop to {recipient}". Case 1 sends to 0xeeDB…01E8, which is not the signer.
findings.fix: Optional wording: "Claim your vested BLAST airdrop and send it to {recipient}".
